privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This website limits data collection to what is necessary and explains what happens when you use the contact form.
privacy.responsible.title: Data controller
privacy.responsible.body: The data controller is Ludovic Trichereau, an individual based in Meulan-en-Yvelines, France.
privacy.form.title: Contact form
privacy.form.body1: The form asks for your name, email address, a subject and the details of your request. When you submit it, this information is sent over HTTPS to Formspree, which forwards the request to the publisher and keeps a copy in its dashboard.
privacy.form.body2: This data is used to identify the sender, understand and handle the request, and reply. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in responding to a voluntary enquiry. Contact details are not used for marketing, and no profiling takes place.
privacy.form.body3: When the form is submitted, Formspree may also process technical request information such as IP address, browser and submission time to provide and secure its service. See Formspree’s privacy policy.
privacy.language.title: Language preference
privacy.language.body: Your language choice (French or English) is saved in your browser’s local storage (localStorage) to remember your preference. It remains on your device and is not sent to the publisher. You can erase it in your browser’s storage settings.
privacy.recipients.title: Recipients and third-party services
privacy.recipients.formspree: Formspree, the form service provider, receives the information you enter and forwards it to the publisher. Submissions are also available in its dashboard. Formspree may process data in the United States or other countries; details about transfers and safeguards are available in its privacy policy.
privacy.recipients.google: The publisher’s contact email is provided by Gmail, so Google may process correspondence and technical email data. See Google’s privacy policy.
privacy.recipients.github: The website is hosted by GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical connection data, such as IP address, request time and browser information, to provide and secure hosting. See GitHub’s privacy statement.
privacy.recipients.cloudflare: The site does not use third-party icon or font libraries loaded from an external CDN, and no advertising or audience-measurement tracking scripts are injected automatically. The services actually used to operate the site are GitHub Pages, Formspree and Gmail.
privacy.recipients.transfers: These providers may process technical data outside the European Union, depending on their infrastructure and the safeguards they apply.
privacy.retention.title: Retention and security
privacy.retention.body1: The website does not maintain a contact database. A copy of each submission is kept in the Formspree dashboard under that service’s retention terms, including as needed to provide the service and depending on account activity. The publisher can delete submissions from the dashboard. Email correspondence is kept by the publisher for as long as needed to handle and follow up on the request.
privacy.retention.body2: The language preference remains on your device until it is replaced or erased by you. GitHub, Google and other providers may apply their own retention periods to logs and backups.
privacy.trackers.title: Cookies and trackers
privacy.trackers.body1: The website does not use advertising, tracking or audience-measurement cookies. The language preference is stored in localStorage, not in a cookie, to support the language selector.
privacy.trackers.body2: Links to third-party websites do not load their content until you open them. Their use is subject to their own privacy policies.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body1: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, rectification or erasure of your data, restriction of processing, or object to processing. To exercise your rights regarding a submission or request its deletion from the Formspree dashboard, email ludot84.dev@gmail.com.
privacy.rights.body2: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL.
privacy.rights.body3: This policy may be updated if the website’s features or data processing change.
